feeds.description: Tynker makes it fun and easy to learn computer programming. Get started today with Tynker's easy-to-learn, visual programming courses designed for young learners in grades K-12.

feeds.title: Coding Lab Blog
feeds.description: Coding Lab is a coding courses for students aged 4-18. Singapore's premier school for programming. Stretching children with our award-winning, MIT inspired curriculum. Read our thoughts, behind the scenes and fun we have as we nurture our next generation of technology leaders through our coding for children programmes.

feeds.title: CodaKid Blog
feeds.description: CodaKid is an online kids coding academy and tech camp that teaches kids to create games, apps, and Minecraft mods using real programming languages and professional tools. CodaKid's online classes are self-paced and include live support from a friendly team of engineers.

feeds.title: Coder Kids Blog
feeds.description: Since 2016, Coder Kids has been a provider of classes and lessons to thousands of kids in grades K-12. We care about providing high quality coding instruction at a reasonable price. Our mission is learning how to code that engages kids' minds in critical thinking and prepares them for an increasingly tech-driven world. Learn more about Coder Kids, technology, and why we offer the best summer camps and after school programs around.

feeds.title: Koderon Blog
feeds.description: Most parents realize that coding (aka computer programming) is a key to future success in any field, yet quality education is lacking in all but the most affluent neighborhoods. Find out everything you need to know about coding education for kids. Koderon offers the best online coding classes for kids ages 7-18.

feeds.title: CodeMonkey Blog
feeds.description: CodeMonkey is a leading coding for kids program. Through its award-winning courses, millions of students learn how to code in real programming languages. It offers an engaging and enjoyable curriculum for schools, after-school clubs, and camps as well as self-paced online courses to learn coding at home.

feeds.title: CodeWizardsHQ
feeds.description: CodeWizardsHQ blog has the best resources for coding for kids. Coding and STEM tutorials, activities, and news for parents and kids. Learn Scratch, HTML/CSS, and Python with CodeWizardsHQ.

feeds.title: Saturday Kids Blog
feeds.description: Inspiring kids to invent a better future through code. Coding for curious kids ages 5-14, available offline and online year-round.

feeds.description: One-stop solution to all your queries related to tutoring for your kids, be it maths, technology, coding, robotics etc. You will find everything here at Wiingy's blog. Wiingy provides an experiential teacher-led online technology education to K12 students across the globe.
